duas.transliteration: Allahumma ma amsa bee min niAAmatin, aw bi-ahadin min khalqik, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.english: O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health. None has the right to be worshipped except You. O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
duas.transliteration: Allahumma AAafinee fee badanee, allahumma AAafinee fee samAAee, allahumma AAafinee fee basaree, la ilaha illa anta. Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-kufri, walfaqri, Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabri, la ilaha illa anta.
duas.note: Recite this dua three times

duas.arabic: حَسۡبِیَ اللّٰہُ  لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ   ؕ عَلَیۡہِ تَوَکَّلۡتُ وَ ہُوَ رَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡعَظِیۡمِ
duas.english: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.
duas.transliteration: Hasbiyal-lahu la ilaha illa huwa, AAalayhi tawakkalt, wahuwa rabbul-AAarshil-Aaatheem

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ. (ثلاثاً إِذا أمسى)
duas.english: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil He has created. (three times in the evening)
duas.transliteration: aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
duas.note: Recite this dua three times

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَاىَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي وَاحْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَىَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in this world and in the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religious and my worldly affairs. O Allah, conceal my faults, calm my fears, and protect me from before me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in You from being taken unaware from beneath me.
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’alukal-’afwa wal-’afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as’alukal-’afwa wal-’afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahum-mastur ‘awrati, wa amin raw’ati wahfazni min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfi, wa ‘an yamini wa ‘an shimali, wa min fawqi, wa ‘audhu bika an ughtala min tahti

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشَرَكِهِ وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
duas.english: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, there is none worthy of worship except You, Lord of everything and its Owner, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Shaitan and his Shirk, or that I should do some evil to myself or bring it upon a Muslim.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma faatiras-samaawaati wal’ardhi, Aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadati, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta, rabba kulli shai’in wa malīkahu, ‘a’oothu bika min sharri nafsee, wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa sharakihi, wa ‘an ‘aqtarifa ‘alaa nafsee soo’an, ‘aw ‘ajurrahu ‘ilaa Muslimin

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.english: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens and He is The All-Seeing, The All-Knowing.(three times)
duas.transliteration: Bismil-lahil-lathee la yadurru maAAas-mihi shay-on fil-ardi wala fis-sama-i wahuwas-sameeAAul-AAaleem.
duas.note: Recite this dua three times

duas.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللّٰهِ رَبًّا وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا
duas.english: I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Islam as a religion and Muhammad peace be upon to him as a Prophet.
duas.transliteration: Radeetu billahi rabban wabil-islami deenan wabiMuhammadin nabiyya.
duas.note: Make it a habit to recite this dua every morning or evening! Allah has promised that anyone who says this three times every morning or evening will be pleased on the Day of Resurrection.

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰہِ   وَبِحَمۡدِہِ . (مائة مرة)
duas.english: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.(one hundred times)
duas.transliteration: Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih.
duas.note: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: whoever say this dua at morning & evening (100 times), none shall come on the Day of Ressurection with anything better except someone who has said the same or even more.

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ . (مائة مرة)
duas.english: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. (one hundred times)
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer.
duas.note: Whoever recites this one hundred times a day will have the reward of freeing ten slaves. One hundred Hasanaat (rewards) will be written for him and one hundred misdeeds will be washed away. He will be shielded from Satan until the evening. No one will be able to present anything better than this except for someone who has recited more than this.

duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا اللَّيْلَةَ فَتْحَهُ وَنَصْرَهُ وَنُورَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ وَهُدَاهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
duas.english: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it.
duas.transliteration: Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathal-lailata, fat-hahu, wanasrahu, wanoorahu, wabarakatahu, wahudahu, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feehi, washarri ma baAAdah.

duas.arabic: فَسُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰہِ حِیۡنَ تُمۡسُوۡنَ وَ حِیۡنَ تُصۡبِحُوۡنَ وَ لَہُ الۡحَمۡدُ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضِ وَ عَشِیًّا وَّ حِیۡنَ تُظۡہِرُوۡنَ، یُخۡرِجُ الۡحَیَّ مِنَ الۡمَیِّتِ وَ یُخۡرِجُ الۡمَیِّتَ مِنَ الۡحَیِّ وَ یُحۡیِ الۡاَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِہَا، وَ کَذٰلِکَ تُخۡرَجُوۡنَ
duas.english: So glorify Allah [above all that (evil) they associate with Him (O believers)], when you come up to the evening [i.e. offer the (Maghrib) sunset and (‘Isha’) night prayers], and when you enter the morning [i.e offer the (Fajr) morning prayer]. And His is all the praises and thanks in the heavens and the earth, and (glorify Him) in the afternoon (i.e. offer ‘Asr prayer) and when you come up to the time, when the day begins to decline (i.e offer Zuhr prayer). (Ibn ‘Abbas said: ‘These are the five compulsory congregational prayers mentioned in the Quran).’ He brings out the living from the dead, and brings out the dead from the living. And He revives the earth after its death. And thus shall you be brought out (resurrected).
duas.transliteration: Fasubhana Allahi heenatumsoona waheena tusbihoon. Walahu alhamdu fee assamawatiwal-ardi waAAashiyyan waheena tuthhiroon. Yukhriju alhayya mina almayyitiwayukhriju almayyita mina alhayyi wayuhyee al-ardabaAAda mawtiha wakathalika tukhrajoon.

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.english: Glorified is Allah and praised is He. Glorified is Allah the most great.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanal-laahi wa bihamdihi, Subhaanal-laahil-’Adheem.

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰهُ اَکۡبَرُ
duas.english: Glory is to Allah, and praise is to Allah, and there is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaahi, walhamdu lillaahi, wa laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu, wallaahu ‘Akbar.
duas.note: This dua is very close to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'Saying this dua is more beloved to me than everything the sun has risen over (i.e the whole world).'

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ‏
duas.english: Allah is free from imperfection and His is the praise
duas.transliteration: Subhan-Allahi wa bihamdihi
duas.note: Recite this Dua one hundred times a day and you will have your sins forgiven by Allah even if they are like the foam of the sea.

duas.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ
duas.english: There is no might and no power except by Allah.
duas.transliteration: Laa hawla wa laa quwwata ‘illaa billaah
duas.note: This dua is considered one of the treasures of Jannah! The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'O Abdullah bin Qais, should I not inform you to one of the treasures of Paradise?' I said, 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah.' So, he recited this dua.

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.english: Glorified is Allah the Most Great and praised is He.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaahil-’Adheemi wa bihamdihi.
duas.note: Recite this dua and sow a tree for yourself in Jannah now! The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever recites this dua will have a palm tree planted for him in the Paradise.'

duas.arabic: ہُوَ اللّٰہُ الَّذِیۡ لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ ۚ عٰلِمُ الۡغَیۡبِ وَ الشَّہَادَۃِ ۚ ہُوَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ الرَّحِیۡمُ. ہُوَ اللّٰہُ الَّذِیۡ لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ ۚ اَلۡمَلِکُ الۡقُدُّوۡسُ السَّلٰمُ الۡمُؤۡمِنُ الۡمُہَیۡمِنُ الۡعَزِیۡزُ الۡجَبَّارُ الۡمُتَکَبِّرُ ؕ سُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰہِ عَمَّا یُشۡرِکُوۡنَ. ہُوَ اللّٰہُ الۡخَالِقُ الۡبَارِئُ الۡمُصَوِّرُ لَہُ الۡاَسۡمَآءُ الۡحُسۡنٰی ؕ یُسَبِّحُ لَہٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضِ ۚ وَ ہُوَ الۡعَزِیۡزُ الۡحَکِیۡمُ
duas.english: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him. He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
duas.transliteration: Huwa Allahu allathee lailaha illa huwa AAalimu alghaybi washshahadatihuwa arrahmanu arraheem. Huwa Allahu allathee lailaha illa huwa almaliku alquddoosu assalamualmul mominul muhayminu alAAazeezu aljabbaru almutakabbirusubhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoon. Huwa Allahu alkhaliqu albari-oalmusawwiru lahu al-asmao alhusnayusabbihu lahu ma fee assamawatiwal-ardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeem.

duas.arabic: مَا شَآءَ اللّٰہُ ۙ لَا قُوَّۃَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰہِ
duas.english: What Allah willed [has occurred], there is no power except in Allah.
duas.transliteration: Ma shaa Allahu la quwwata illabillahi

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ، سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ  رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
duas.english: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, with no partner or associate. His is the dominion and all praise is to Him, and He is Able to do all things. Glory is to Allah, praise is to Allah, none has the right to be worshiped but Allah, Allah is the Most Great, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Supreme. O Lord, forgive me.
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer, subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-AAaliyyil AAatheem. Rabbigh-fir lee

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.english: Glory to my Lord the Exalted.
duas.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbiyal-’Adheem
duas.note: Recite this dua three times

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
duas.english: Glory is to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise is Yours. O Allah, forgive me.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanaka Allaahumma Rabbanaa wa bihamdika Allaahum-maghfir lee

duas.arabic: سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
duas.english: Glory (to You), Most Holy (are You), Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
duas.transliteration: Subboohun, Quddoosun, Rabbul-malaa’ikati warrooh

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ
duas.english: Glory is to You, Master of power, of dominion, of majesty and greatness.
duas.transliteration: Subhaana thil-jabarooti, walmalakooti, walkibriyaa’i, wal’adhamati

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى
duas.english: Glory is to my Lord, the Most High.
duas.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbiyal-A ‘laa
duas.note: Recite this dua three times

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ . (مائة مرة)
duas.english: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. (one hundred times)
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer.
duas.note: Whoever recites this one hundred times a day will have the reward of freeing ten slaves. One hundred Hasanaat (rewards) will be written for him and one hundred misdeeds will be washed away. He will be shielded from Satan until the evening. No one will be able to present anything better than this except for someone who has recited more than this.

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللّٰهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ، وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
duas.english: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, He has no partner, His is the dominion and His is the praise and He is Able to do all things. There is no power and no might except by Allah . None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and we do not worship any other besides Him . His is grace, and His is bounty and to Him belongs the most excellent praise. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah . (We are) sincere in making our religious devotion to Him, even though the disbelievers may dislike it.
duas.transliteration: Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku, wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa ‘alaa kulli shay ‘in Qadeer. Laa hawla wa laa quwwata ‘illaa billaahi, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu, wa laa na’budu ‘illaa ‘iyyaahu, lahun-ni’matu wa lahul-fadhlu wa lahuth-thanaa’ul-hasanu, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu mukhliseena lahud-deena wa law karihal-kaafiroon

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
duas.english: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, by the multitude of His creation, by His Pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His Words.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdihi ‘Adada khalqihi, wa ridhaa nafsihi, wa zinata ‘arshihi wa midaada kalimaatihi

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰہِ، وَالۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ، وَاللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ
duas.english: Glory is to Allah, praise is to Allah, Allah is the Most Great!
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaahi, Walhamdu lillaahi, Wallaahu ‘Akbar
duas.note: Remember Allah SWT now! Start off with this easy Dhikr! Recite Subhanallah - 33 times, Alhamdhulillah - 33 times and Allahu Akbar 34 times.

duas.arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُئْوِيَ
duas.english: All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamana wasaqana, wakafana, wa-awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wala mu/wee.

duas.arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ،  غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ،  وَلاَ مُوَدَّعٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ،  رَبَّنَا
duas.english: Praise be to Allah abundantly and sincerely, of such a nature as is productive of blessing, is not insufficient, Abandoned, or ignored, O our lord.
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu li l-lah kathiran taiyiban mubarakan fihi ghaira makfiy wala muWada` wala mustaghna’anhu Rabbana.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اَوۡزِعۡنِیۡۤ اَنۡ اَشۡکُرَ نِعۡمَتَکَ الَّتِیۡۤ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَیَّ وَ عَلٰی وَالِدَیَّ وَ اَنۡ اَعۡمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرۡضٰہُ وَ اَصۡلِحۡ لِیۡ فِیۡ ذُرِّیَّتِیۡ ۚؕ اِنِّیۡ تُبۡتُ اِلَیۡکَ وَ اِنِّیۡ مِنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِیۡنَ
duas.english: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi’nee an ashkura ni’mataka allatee anAAamta AAalayya waAAalawalidayya waan aAAmala salihan tardahuwaaslih lee fee thurriyyatee innee tubtuilayka wa-innee mina almuslimeen

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اَوۡزِعۡنِیۡۤ اَنۡ اَشۡکُرَ نِعۡمَتَکَ الَّتِیۡۤ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَیَّ وَ عَلٰی وَالِدَیَّ وَ اَنۡ اَعۡمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرۡضٰىہُ وَ اَدۡخِلۡنِیۡ بِرَحۡمَتِکَ فِیۡ عِبَادِکَ الصّٰلِحِیۡنَ
duas.english: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awziAAnee an ashkura niAAmataka allateeanAAamta AAalayya waAAala walidayya waan aAAmala salihantardahu waadkhilnee birahmatika fee AAibadikaassaliheen
duas.note: Prophet Sulaiman (AS) asked this dua.

duas.arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
duas.english: Praise is to Allah by Whose grace good deeds are completed.
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi bi ni’matihi tatimmus-salihaat

groups.title: For leaving everything in the hands of Allah

duas.arabic: قُلِ اللّٰہُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضِ عٰلِمَ الۡغَیۡبِ وَ الشَّہَادَۃِ اَنۡتَ تَحۡکُمُ بَیۡنَ عِبَادِکَ فِیۡ مَا کَانُوۡا فِیۡہِ یَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ
duas.english: Say (O Muhammad SAW): ‘O Allah! Creator of the heavens and the earth! All-Knower of the Ghaib (unseen) and the seen. You will judge between your slaves about that wherein they used to differ.’
duas.transliteration: Quli allahumma fatira assamawatiwal-ardi AAalima alghaybi washshahadatianta tahkumu bayna AAibadika fee ma kanoofeehi yakhtalifoon

duas.arabic: اَنۡتَ وَلِیُّنَا فَاغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَ ارۡحَمۡنَا وَ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الۡغٰفِرِیۡنَ وَ اکۡتُبۡ لَنَا فِیۡ ہٰذِہِ الدُّنۡیَا حَسَنَۃً وَّ فِی الۡاٰخِرَۃِ  اِنَّا ہُدۡنَاۤ  اِلَیۡکَ
duas.english: (O my Lord) You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us; and You are the best of forgivers. And ordain for us good in this world, and in the Hereafter. Certainly we have turned unto You.
duas.transliteration: Anta waliyyuna faghfirlana warhamna waanta khayru alghafireen. Waktub lana fee hathihi ddunya hasanatan wafee al-akhiratiinna hudna ilayk
duas.note: This dua was asked by prophet Musa (AS).

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا فَاغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَ ارۡحَمۡنَا وَ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الرّٰحِمِیۡنَ
duas.english: Our Lord! We believe, so forgive us, and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of all who show mercy!
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa Aamannaa Faghfir Lanaa Warh’amnaa Wa Anta Khayrur Raah’imeen
duas.note: Allah SWT said the believers will ask this dua.

duas.arabic: رَّبِّ اغۡفِرۡ وَ ارۡحَمۡ وَ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الرّٰحِمِیۡنَ
duas.english: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of those who show mercy!
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir Warh’am Wa Anta Khayrur Raah’imeen
duas.note: Read this dua now! Allah SWT taught this dua to the Prophet SAW.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمۡنَاۤ اَنۡفُسَنَا ٜ وَ اِنۡ لَّمۡ تَغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَ تَرۡحَمۡنَا لَنَکُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡخٰسِرِیۡنَ
duas.english: Our Lord! We have wronged our own souls: If thou forgive us not and bestow not upon us Thy Mercy, we shall certainly be lost.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusina wa il lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lana kunan minal-khasireen
duas.note: Read this dua to atone your sins! Prophet Adam (AS) and Hawwa (AS) asked forgiveness from Allah by reciting this dua.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اٰتِنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ رَحۡمَۃً وَّ ہَیِّیٔۡ لَنَا مِنۡ اَمۡرِنَا رَشَدًا
duas.english: Our Lord! Bestow on us Mercy from Thyself, and dispose of our affair for us in the right way!
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa Aatina Mil Ladunka Rah’mataw Wa Hayyi Lanaa Min Amrinaa Rashadaa
duas.note: The cave companions asked this dua to Allah.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اِنِّیۡۤ اَعُوۡذُ بِکَ اَنۡ اَسۡـَٔلَکَ مَا لَـیۡسَ لِیۡ بِہٖ عِلۡمٌ ؕ وَ اِلَّا تَغۡفِرۡ لِیۡ وَ تَرۡحَمۡنِیۡۤ  اَکُنۡ مِّنَ الۡخٰسِرِیۡنَ
duas.english: O my Lord! I seek refuge with You from asking You that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have Mercy on me, I would indeed be one of the losers.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi Inneee A-o’od’u Bika An As-alaka Maa Laysa Lee Bihee I’lm Wa Illaa Taghfirlee Wa Tarh’amneee Akum Minal Khaasireen

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
duas.english: Lord, forgive me. My Lord, forgive me.
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir lee, Rabbighfir lee

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَعَافِنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
duas.english: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, heal me, and provide for me.
duas.transliteration: Allaahum-maghfir lee, warhamnee, wa ‘aafinee, wahdinee, warzuqnee

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ وَعَلاَنِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
duas.english: O Allah, forgive me all my sins, great and small, the first and the last, those that are apparent and those that are hidden.
duas.transliteration: Allaahum-maghfir lee thanbee kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa ‘awwalahu wa ‘aakhirahu wa ‘alaaniyata hu wa sirrahu

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَاَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لَا أُحصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek protection in Your pleasure from Your anger, and I seek protection in Your forgiveness from Your punishment. I seek protection in You from You. I cannot count Your praises. You are as You have praised Yourself.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘a’oothu biridhaaka min sakhatika, wa bimu’aafaatika min ‘uqoobatika wa ‘a’oothu bika minka, laa ‘uhsee thanaa’an ‘alayka ‘Anta kamaa ‘athnayta ‘alaa nafsika

duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ  (ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ)
duas.english: I ask Allah’s pardon and turn to Him in repentance. (Three Times)
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaaha wa ‘atoobu ‘ilayhi
duas.note: Seek forgiveness from Allah (SWT) with this dua anytime of the day!

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْماً كَثِيراً، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.english: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself and no one forgives sins but You. So, grant me forgiveness and have mercy on me. Surely, you are Forgiving, Merciful.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee dhalamtu nafsee dhulman katheeran, wa laa yaghfiruth-thunooba ‘illaa ‘Anta, faghfir lee maghfiratan min ‘indika warhamnee ‘innaka ‘Antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ،  خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ،  وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ،  أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ،  أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ،  وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِر لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.english: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbee la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa-ana AAabduk, wa-ana AAala AAahdika wawaAAdika mas-tataAAt, aAAoothu bika min sharri ma sanaAAt, aboo-o laka biniAAmatika AAalay, wa-aboo-o bithanbee, faghfir lee fa-innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.
duas.note: Whoever recites this with conviction in the evening and dies during that night shall enter Paradise, and whoever recites it with conviction in the morning and dies during that day shall enter Paradise.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which encompasses all things, that You forgive me.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘as’aluka birahmatikal-latee wasi’at kulla shay’in ‘an taghfira lee

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِـرْ لي، وَتُبْ عَلَـيَّ،  إِنَّكَ أَنْـتَ التَّـوّابُ الغَـفُورُ
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance, You are the Ever-Relenting, the All-Forgiving.
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir lee wa tub ‘alayya ‘innaka ‘Antat-Tawwaabul-Ghafoor

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغۡفِرۡ لِیۡ وَ لِاَخِیۡ وَ اَدۡخِلۡنَا فِیۡ رَحۡمَتِکَ وَ اَنۡتَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِیۡنَ
duas.english: O my Lord! Forgive me and my brother, and make us enter into Your Mercy, for you are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lee wali akhee wa adkhilna fee rahmatika wa anta arhamur rahimeen
duas.note: This dua was asked by prophet Musa (AS).

groups.title: For asking forgiveness for yourself and anyone who enters your house

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغۡفِرۡ لِیۡ وَ لِوَالِدَیَّ وَ لِمَنۡ دَخَلَ بَیۡتِیَ مُؤۡمِنًا وَّ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ وَ الۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِ وَ لَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ اِلَّا تَبَارًا
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lee waliwalidayyawaliman dakhala baytiya mu’minan walil mu’mineena wal mu’minati wala tazidi aththalimeena illatabaran

duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لاَ  إِلَهَ إلاَّ هُوَ الحَيُّ القَيّوُمُ وأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ
duas.english: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, Whom there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Living, the Eternal, and I repent to Him.
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaah alladhee laa ilaaha illaa huwal hayyul qayyoomu wa atoobu ilayhi
duas.note: Seek forgiveness with this dua! The Prophet (peace be upon him) said whoever recites this dua will be forgiven by Allah even if he fled during the advance of an army.

duas.arabic: ذٰلِکُمُ اللّٰہُ رَبِّیۡ عَلَیۡہِ تَوَکَّلۡتُ وَ اِلَیۡہِ اُنِیۡبُ
duas.english: (And say O Muhammad SAW to these polytheists:) Such is Allah, my Lord in Whom I put my trust, and to Him I turn in all of my affairs and in repentance.
duas.transliteration: Dhalikumu Allahu rabbee alayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi uneeb

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلۡ مِنَّا ؕ اِنَّکَ اَنۡتَ السَّمِیۡعُ الۡعَلِیۡمُ
duas.english: Our Lord! Accept (this service) from us: For Thou art the All-Hearing, the All-knowing.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka antas Sameeaul Aleem

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَ اجۡعَلۡنَا مُسۡلِمَیۡنِ لَکَ وَ مِنۡ ذُرِّیَّتِنَاۤ اُمَّۃً مُّسۡلِمَۃً لَّکَ ۪ وَ اَرِنَا مَنَاسِکَنَا وَ تُبۡ عَلَیۡنَا ۚ اِنَّکَ اَنۡتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِیۡمُ
duas.english: Our Lord! Make of us Muslims, bowing to Thy (Will), and of our progeny a people Muslim, bowing to Thy (will); and show us our place for the celebration of (due) rites; and turn unto us (in Mercy); for Thou art the Oft-Returning, Most Merciful.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana wa-j’alna Muslimayni laka wa min Dhurriyatina ‘Ummatan Muslimatan laka wa ‘Arina Manasikana wa tub ‘alayna ‘innaka ‘antat-Tawwabu-Raheem

groups.title: For protection and help from Allah

duas.arabic: قُلۡ ہُوَ اللّٰہُ اَحَدٌ،  اَللّٰہُ الصَّمَدُ،  لَمۡ یَلِدۡ وَ لَمۡ یُوۡلَدۡوَ لَمۡ یَکُنۡ لَّہٗ  کُفُوًا اَحَدٌ
duas.english: He is Allah (the) One. The Self-Sufficient Master, Whom all creatures need, He begets not nor was He begotten, and there is none equal to Him.
duas.transliteration: Qul Huwallaahu ‘Ahad. Allaahus-Samad. Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. Wa lam yaku-llahu kufuwan ‘ahad

duas.arabic: اَللّٰہُ لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ اَلۡحَیُّ الۡقَیُّوۡمُ لَا تَاۡخُذُہٗ سِنَۃٌ وَّ لَا نَوۡمٌ  لَہٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الۡاَرۡضِ مَنۡ ذَا الَّذِیۡ یَشۡفَعُ عِنۡدَہٗۤ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِہٖ  یَعۡلَمُ مَا بَیۡنَ اَیۡدِیۡہِمۡ وَ مَا خَلۡفَہُمۡ  وَ لَا یُحِیۡطُوۡنَ بِشَیۡءٍ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِہٖۤ اِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ وَسِعَ کُرۡسِیُّہُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضَ  وَ لَا یَـُٔوۡدُہٗ حِفۡظُہُمَا  وَ ہُوَ الۡعَلِیُّ الۡعَظِیۡمُ
duas.english: Allah! There is none worthy of worship but He, the Ever Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His Permission? He knows what happens to them in this world, and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never compass anything of His Knowledge except that which He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.transliteration: Allaahu laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta’khuthuhu sinatun wa laa nawm, lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maafil-’ardh, man thal-lathee yashfa’u ‘indahu ‘illaa bi’ithnih, ya’lamu maa bayna ‘aydeehim wa maa khalfahum, wa laa yuheetoona bishay’im-min ‘ilmihi ‘illaa bimaa shaa’a, wasi’a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal’ardh, wa laa ya’ooduhu hifdhuhumaa, wa Huwal-’Aliyyul- ‘Adheem

duas.arabic: قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ الۡفَلَقِ،  مِنۡ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ اِذَا وَقَب،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ النَّفّٰثٰتِ فِی الۡعُقَدِ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ اِذَا حَسَدَ
duas.english: I seek refuge with (Allah) the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, and from the evil of the darkening (night) as it comes with its darkness, and from the evil of those who practice witchcraft when they blow in the knots, and from the evil of the envier when he envies.
duas.transliteration: Qul ‘a’oothu birabbil-falaq. Min sharri maa khalaq. Wa min sharri ghaasiqin ‘ithaa waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffaathaati fil-’uqad. Wa min sharri haasidin ‘ithaa hasad
duas.note: Prophet (S.A.W.) used to seek protection against the evil of jinn and the evil eyes of humans by reciting this Surah.

duas.arabic: قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِکِ النَّاسِ، اِلٰہِ النَّاسِ، مِنۡ شَرِّ الۡوَسۡوَاسِ الۡخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِیۡ یُوَسۡوِسُ فِیۡ صُدُوۡرِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الۡجِنَّۃِ وَ النَّاسِ
duas.english: I seek refuge with (Allah) the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, who whispers in the breasts of mankind, of jinns and men.
duas.transliteration: Qul ‘a’oothu birabbin-naas . Malikin-naas . ‘Ilaahin-naas . Min sharril-waswaasil-khannaas. Allathee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin-naas. Minal-jinnati wannaas

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ،  وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ،  وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ  اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I seek refuge in You from the trial of the False Messiah, and I seek refuge in You from the trials of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and from debt.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘a’oothu bika min ‘athaabil-qabri, wa ‘a’oothu bika min fitnatil-maseehid-dajjaali, wa ‘a’oothu bika min fitnatil-mahyaa walmamaati. Allaahumma ‘innee ‘a’oothu bika minal-ma’thami walmaghrami

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
duas.english: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day Your servants are resurrected.
duas.transliteration: Allahumma qinee AAathabaka yawma tabAAathu AAibadak.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشَرَكِهِ وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
duas.english: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, there is none worthy of worship except You, Lord of everything and its Owner, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Shaitan and his Shirk, or that I should do some evil to myself or bring it upon a Muslim.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma faatiras-samaawaati wal’ardhi, Aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadati, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta, rabba kulli shai’in wa malīkahu, ‘a’oothu bika min sharri nafsee, wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa sharakihi, wa ‘an ‘aqtarifa ‘alaa nafsee soo’an, ‘aw ‘ajurrahu ‘ilaa Muslimin

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَاىَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي وَاحْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَىَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in this world and in the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religious and my worldly affairs. O Allah, conceal my faults, calm my fears, and protect me from before me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in You from being taken unaware from beneath me.
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’alukal-’afwa wal-’afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as’alukal-’afwa wal-’afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahum-mastur ‘awrati, wa amin raw’ati wahfazni min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfi, wa ‘an yamini wa ‘an shimali, wa min fawqi, wa ‘audhu bika an ughtala min tahti

duas.arabic: اَنَّ اللّٰہَ مَوۡلٰىکُمۡ ؕ نِعۡمَ الۡمَوۡلٰی وَ نِعۡمَ النَّصِیۡرُ
duas.english: Know that Allah is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and Excellent is the helper.
duas.transliteration: Anna Allaha mawlakum ni’mal mawla wa ni’man naseer

duas.arabic: رَّبِّ اَعُوۡذُ بِکَ مِنۡ ہَمَزٰتِ الشَّیٰطِیۡنِ وَ اَعُوۡذُ بِکَ رَبِّ اَنۡ یَّحۡضُرُوۡنِ
duas.english: My Lord! I seek refuge with You from the whisperings (suggestions) of the Shayatin (devils). And I seek refuge with You, My Lord! lest they may attend (or come near) me.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ‘a`outhubika min hamazaatish-shayaateeni, wa ‘a`outhu bika rabbi ‘ay-yahdhuroon
duas.note: This dua was taught by Allah SWT to Prophet (peace be upon him)

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
duas.english: I seek refuge with Allah against the Satan, the outcast.
duas.transliteration: A’oothu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem

groups.title: For protection from the evil eye

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.english: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.transliteration: A’oothu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaqa
duas.note: Prophet (S.A.W.) said "When anyone lands at a place, and says these words, nothing would harm him until he marches from that stopping place."

groups.title: To keep your family safe from transgressors

duas.arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِیۡ وَ اَہۡلِیۡ مِمَّا یَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
duas.english: My Lord! Save me and my family from what they do.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi najjinee waahlee mimma ya’maloon.
duas.note: This dua was asked by Prophet Lut (AS).

duas.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ
duas.english: I seek protection for you in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every beast, and from every envious blameworthy eye.
duas.transliteration: U’eethukumaa bikalimaatil-laahit-taammati min kulli shaytaanin wa haammatin, wa min kulli ‘aynin laammatin
duas.note: Seek protection by reciting this dua! Ibn'Abbas related that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) used to seek Allah's protection for Al-Hassan and Al-Hussain by reciting this dua.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡ ہٰذِہِ الۡقَرۡیَۃِ الظَّالِمِ اَہۡلُہَا وَ اجۡعَلۡ لَّنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ وَلِیًّا وَّ اجۡعَلۡ لَّنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ نَصِیۡرًا
duas.english: Our Lord! Rescue us from this town whose people are oppressors; and raise for us from You one who will protect, and raise for us from You one who will help.
duas.transliteration: rabbana akhrijna min hathihialqaryati aththalimi ahluhawajAAal lana min ladunka waliyyan wajAAallana min ladunka naseera
duas.note: This dua was asked by the early Muslims of the Makkah city when the Quruaish tribe oppressed them.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي وَنَصِيرِي بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ
duas.english: O Allah, You are my aid ane my support. By Your defend, by You I attack and by Your I fight.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ‘Anta ‘adhudee, wa ‘Anta naseeree, bika ‘ahoolu, wa bika ‘asoolu, wa bika ‘uqaatilu

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
duas.english: Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift to account, defeat the groups (of disbelievers). O Allah, defeat them and shake them.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma munzilal-kitaabi, saree’al-hisaabi-hzimil-’ahzaaba- Allaahumma-hzimhum wa zalzilhum

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ
duas.english: O Allah, suffice (i.e. protect) me against them however You wish.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummak-fineehim bimaa shi’ta

duas.arabic: لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّاۤ اللّٰہُ
duas.english: There is none worthy of worship but Allah.
duas.transliteration: Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu

duas.arabic: عَلَی اللّٰہِ تَوَکَّلۡنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا فِتۡنَۃً  لِّلۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ وَ نَجِّنَا بِرَحۡمَتِکَ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ
duas.english: Upon Allah do we rely. Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people. And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
duas.transliteration: Alal Allahi thawakkalna rabbana la taj’alna fitnatal lil-qawmidh-Dhalimeen. Wa najjina bi-Rahmatika minal qawmil kafireen.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ،  وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I associate anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I know not.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘a’oothu bika ‘an ‘ushrika bika wa ‘anaa ‘a’lamu, wa ‘astaghfiruka limaa laa ‘a’lamu

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا مَعَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ
duas.english: Our Lord! Place us not with the people who are Zaalimoon (polytheists and wrong doers).
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa Laa Taj-a’lnaa Ma – A’l Qawmiz’ Z’aalimeen

duas.arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِیۡ فِی الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ
duas.english: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi fala tajAAalnee fee alqawmi aththalimeen
duas.note: Allah taught this dua to Prophet (peace be upon him).

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.english: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens and He is The All-Seeing, The All-Knowing.(three times)
duas.transliteration: Bismil-lahil-lathee la yadurru maAAas-mihi shay-on fil-ardi wala fis-sama-i wahuwas-sameeAAul-AAaleem.
duas.note: Recite this dua three times

duas.arabic: اَللّٰہُ لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ اَلۡحَیُّ الۡقَیُّوۡمُ لَا تَاۡخُذُہٗ سِنَۃٌ وَّ لَا نَوۡمٌ  لَہٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الۡاَرۡضِ مَنۡ ذَا الَّذِیۡ یَشۡفَعُ عِنۡدَہٗۤ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِہٖ  یَعۡلَمُ مَا بَیۡنَ اَیۡدِیۡہِمۡ وَ مَا خَلۡفَہُمۡ  وَ لَا یُحِیۡطُوۡنَ بِشَیۡءٍ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِہٖۤ اِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ وَسِعَ کُرۡسِیُّہُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضَ  وَ لَا یَـُٔوۡدُہٗ حِفۡظُہُمَا  وَ ہُوَ الۡعَلِیُّ الۡعَظِیۡمُ
duas.english: Allah! There is none worthy of worship but He, the Ever Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His Permission? He knows what happens to them in this world, and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never compass anything of His Knowledge except that which He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.transliteration: Allaahu laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta’khuthuhu sinatun wa laa nawm, lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maafil-’ardh, man thal-lathee yashfa’u ‘indahu ‘illaa bi’ithnih, ya’lamu maa bayna ‘aydeehim wa maa khalfahum, wa laa yuheetoona bishay’im-min ‘ilmihi ‘illaa bimaa shaa’a, wasi’a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal’ardh, wa laa ya’ooduhu hifdhuhumaa, wa Huwal-’Aliyyul- ‘Adheem
duas.note: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'When you are about to sleep, recite Ayatul Kursi till the end of the verse for there will remain over you a protection from Allah and no devil will draw near to you until morning'.

duas.arabic:
[سُوۡرَةُ الإخلاص] 
 قُلۡ ہُوَ اللّٰہُ اَحَدٌ،  اَللّٰہُ الصَّمَدُ،  لَمۡ یَلِدۡ وَ لَمۡ یُوۡلَدۡوَ لَمۡ یَکُنۡ لَّہٗ  کُفُوًا اَحَدٌ 

[سُوۡرَةُ الفَلَق]
 قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ الۡفَلَقِ،  مِنۡ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ اِذَا وَقَب،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ النَّفّٰثٰتِ فِی الۡعُقَدِ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ اِذَا حَسَدَ 

[سُوۡرَةُ  النَّاس]
 قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِکِ النَّاسِ، اِلٰہِ النَّاسِ، مِنۡ شَرِّ الۡوَسۡوَاسِ الۡخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِیۡ یُوَسۡوِسُ فِیۡ صُدُوۡرِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الۡجِنَّۃِ وَ النَّاسِ
duas.english: [Surah Al-Ikhlas] Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge, He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent. [Surah Al-Falaq] Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, From the evil of that which He created, And from the evil of darkness when it settles, And from the evil of the blowers in knots, And from the evil of an envier when he envies. [Surah An-Nas] Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer, Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind, From among the jinn and mankind.
duas.transliteration: [Surah Al-Ikhlas]Qul Huwa-llahu ‘Ahad, Allahus-Samad, Lam Yalid Wa Lam Yulad, Walam Yakul-La-Hu-Kufuwan ‘Ahad. [Surah Al-Falaq]Qul ‘A’udhu Bi-Rabbil-Falaq, Min Sharri Ma Khalaq, Wa Min Sharri Ghasiqin ‘Idha Waqab, Wa Min Sharri-Naffathati Fil-‘Uqadi, Wa Min Sharri Hasidin ‘Idha Hasad. [Surah An-Nas]Qul ‘A’udhu Bi-Rabbin-Nas, Malikin-Nas, Ilahin-Nas, Min-Sharril-Waswasil-Khan-Nas, Al-Ladhi Yuwas-wisu Fee Sudurin-Nas, Mina Al-Jinnati Wan-Nas.

duas.arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُئْوِيَ
duas.english: All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamana wasaqana, wakafana, wa-awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wala mu/wee.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ والشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّموَاتِ والأرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ  شَیۡءٍ ومَلِيْكَهُ، أشْهَدُ أنْ لَا إلَهَ إلاَّ أنْتَ، أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
duas.english: O Allah Knower of the Unseen and the Seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything and its Possessor, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except You, I seek refuge from You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Shaitan and his Shirk.
duas.transliteration: Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
duas.english: O Allah! I have surrendered myself over to you and have turned my face towards You, and leave all my affairs to You and depend on You and put my trust in You expecting Your reward and fearing Your punishment. There is neither fleeing from You nor refuge but with You. I believe in the Book (Qur’an) which You have revealed and in Your Prophet (Muhammad) whom You have sent.
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilaika wa fauwadtu `Amri ilaika, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilaika wa aljaatu zahri ilaika, reghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika. La maljaa wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalta; wa nabiyyikalladhi arsalta

duas.arabic: اَللّٰہُ لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ اَلۡحَیُّ الۡقَیُّوۡمُ لَا تَاۡخُذُہٗ سِنَۃٌ وَّ لَا نَوۡمٌ  لَہٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الۡاَرۡضِ مَنۡ ذَا الَّذِیۡ یَشۡفَعُ عِنۡدَہٗۤ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِہٖ  یَعۡلَمُ مَا بَیۡنَ اَیۡدِیۡہِمۡ وَ مَا خَلۡفَہُمۡ  وَ لَا یُحِیۡطُوۡنَ بِشَیۡءٍ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِہٖۤ اِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ وَسِعَ کُرۡسِیُّہُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضَ  وَ لَا یَـُٔوۡدُہٗ حِفۡظُہُمَا  وَ ہُوَ الۡعَلِیُّ الۡعَظِیۡمُ
duas.english: Allah! There is none worthy of worship but He, the Ever Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His Permission? He knows what happens to them in this world, and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never compass anything of His Knowledge except that which He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.transliteration: Allaahu laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta’khuthuhu sinatun wa laa nawm, lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maafil-’ardh, man thal-lathee yashfa’u ‘indahu ‘illaa bi’ithnih, ya’lamu maa bayna ‘aydeehim wa maa khalfahum, wa laa yuheetoona bishay’im-min ‘ilmihi ‘illaa bimaa shaa’a, wasi’a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal’ardh, wa laa ya’ooduhu hifdhuhumaa, wa Huwal-’Aliyyul- ‘Adheem
duas.note: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'When you are about to sleep, recite Ayatul Kursi till the end of the verse for there will remain over you a protection from Allah and no devil will draw near to you until morning'.

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰہِ  (33 times) الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہ  (33 times) اَللّٰہُ اَکۡبَر  (34 times)
duas.english: Glory be to Allah (33 times), Praise be to Allah (33 times), Allah is the greatest (34 times)
duas.transliteration: Subhana-Allah (33 times) Alhamdulillah (33 times) Allahu Akbar (34 times)
duas.note: Prophet (S.A.W.) taught this Tasbih to his beloved daughter Fatima (R.A.) and advised her to recite it every day before sleeping.

duas.arabic:
[سُوۡرَةُ الإخلاص] 
 قُلۡ ہُوَ اللّٰہُ اَحَدٌ،  اَللّٰہُ الصَّمَدُ،  لَمۡ یَلِدۡ وَ لَمۡ یُوۡلَدۡوَ لَمۡ یَکُنۡ لَّہٗ  کُفُوًا اَحَدٌ 

[سُوۡرَةُ الفَلَق]
 قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ الۡفَلَقِ،  مِنۡ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ اِذَا وَقَب،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ النَّفّٰثٰتِ فِی الۡعُقَدِ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ اِذَا حَسَدَ 

[سُوۡرَةُ  النَّاس]
 قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِکِ النَّاسِ، اِلٰہِ النَّاسِ، مِنۡ شَرِّ الۡوَسۡوَاسِ الۡخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِیۡ یُوَسۡوِسُ فِیۡ صُدُوۡرِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الۡجِنَّۃِ وَ النَّاسِ
duas.english: [Surah Al-Ikhlas] Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge, He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent. [Surah Al-Falaq] Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, From the evil of that which He created, And from the evil of darkness when it settles, And from the evil of the blowers in knots, And from the evil of an envier when he envies. [Surah An-Nas] Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer, Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind, From among the jinn and mankind.
duas.transliteration: [Surah Al-Ikhlas]Qul Huwa-llahu ‘Ahad, Allahus-Samad, Lam Yalid Wa Lam Yulad, Walam Yakul-La-Hu-Kufuwan ‘Ahad. [Surah Al-Falaq]Qul ‘A’udhu Bi-Rabbil-Falaq, Min Sharri Ma Khalaq, Wa Min Sharri Ghasiqin ‘Idha Waqab, Wa Min Sharri-Naffathati Fil-‘Uqadi, Wa Min Sharri Hasidin ‘Idha Hasad. [Surah An-Nas]Qul ‘A’udhu Bi-Rabbin-Nas, Malikin-Nas, Ilahin-Nas, Min-Sharril-Waswasil-Khan-Nas, Al-Ladhi Yuwas-wisu Fee Sudurin-Nas, Mina Al-Jinnati Wan-Nas.
duas.note: Whenever the Prophet (S.A.W.) went to bed every night, he used to cup his hands together and blow over it after reciting these three Surahs and then rub his hands over whatever parts of his body he was able to rub, starting with his head, face and front of his body. He used to do that three times.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً،  وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً،  وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit, a good provision, and deeds that will be accepted.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘as’aluka ‘ilman naafi’an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa ‘amalan mutaqabbalan
duas.note: Prophet (S.A.W.) used to recite this dua everday immediately after Fajr Prayer.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek Your protection from the Fire.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘as’alukal-jannata wa ‘a’oothu bika minan-naar

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰهُ اَکۡبَرُ
duas.english: Glory is to Allah, praise is to Allah, there is no god but Allah and Allah is the Most Great.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaahi, Walhamdu lillaahi, Wala Illaha Illallahu, Wallaahu ‘Akbar
duas.note: This dua is very close to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'Saying this dua is more beloved to me than everything the sun has risen over (i.e the whole world).'

duas.arabic: لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ  اِلَّاۤ اَنۡتَ سُبۡحٰنَکَ  اِنِّیۡ کُنۡتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ
duas.english: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrongdoers.
duas.transliteration: Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta subhaanaka ‘innee kuntu minadh-dhaalimeen
duas.note: Prophet Yunus supplicate this Dua to Allah when he was in the belly of the whale.

duas.arabic: بِسۡمِ اللّٰہِ  الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ
duas.english: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
duas.transliteration: Bismi-llahi r-raḥmani r-raḥim

groups.title: For success in this world and aakhira

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اٰتِنَا فِی الدُّنۡیَا حَسَنَۃً وَّ فِی الۡاٰخِرَۃِ حَسَنَۃً وَّ قِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.english: Our Lord! Give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and save us from the torment of the Fire!
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa Aatinaa Fiddunyaa H’asanah Wa Fil Aakhirati H’asanah Wa Qinaa A’d’aaban Naar
duas.note: This is the Prophet's (peace be upon him) most read supplication to Allah. It is a comprehensive dua which contains everything we need for this world and the hereafter. We can recite this dua at all times.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّکَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِیَوۡمٍ لَّا رَیۡبَ فِیۡہِ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰہَ لَا یُخۡلِفُ الۡمِیۡعَادَ
duas.english: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana innaka jami’unnasi li-Yawmil la rayba fi innAllaha la yukhliful mi’aad

duas.arabic: قُلۡ ہُوَ اللّٰہُ اَحَدٌ،  اَللّٰہُ الصَّمَدُ،  لَمۡ یَلِدۡ وَ لَمۡ یُوۡلَدۡوَ لَمۡ یَکُنۡ لَّہٗ  کُفُوًا اَحَدٌ
duas.english: [Surah Al-Ikhlas]Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge, He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
duas.transliteration: [Surah Al-Ikhlas]Qul Huwa-llahu ‘Ahad, Allahus-Samad, Lam Yalid Wa Lam Yulad, Walam Yakul-La-Hu-Kufuwan ‘Ahad.
duas.note: Prophet (S.A.W.) said that reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas (Surah No. 112) one time is equal to one third of the Quran.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً،  وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً،  وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit, a good provision, and deeds that will be accepted.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘as’aluka ‘ilman naafi’an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa ‘amalan mutaqabbalan

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَعَافِنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
duas.english: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, heal me, and provide for me.
duas.transliteration: Allaahum-maghfir lee, warhamnee, wa ‘aafinee, wahdinee, warzuqnee

duas.arabic: اَللّٰہُ لَطِیۡفٌۢ بِعِبَادِہٖ یَرۡزُقُ مَنۡ یَّشَآءُ وَ ہُوَ الۡقَوِیُّ الۡعَزِیۡزُ
duas.english: Allah is very Gracious and Kind to His slaves. He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the All-Strong, the All-Mighty.
duas.transliteration: Allahu lateefun biAAibadihiyarzuqu man yashao wahuwa alqawiyyu alAAazeez

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اَنۡزِلۡ عَلَیۡنَا مَآئِدَۃً مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ تَکُوۡنُ لَنَا عِیۡدًا لِّاَوَّلِنَا وَ اٰخِرِنَا وَ اٰیَۃً مِّنۡکَ ۚ وَ ارۡزُقۡنَا وَ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الرّٰزِقِیۡنَ
duas.english: O Allah our Lord! Send us from heaven a table set (with viands), that there may be for us - for the first and the last of us - a solemn festival and a sign from thee; and provide for our sustenance, for thou art the best Sustainer (of our needs).
duas.transliteration: Rabbana anzil 'alayna ma'idatam minas-Samai takoonu lana 'idal li-awwa-lina wa aakhirina wa ayatam-minka war-zuqna wa anta Khayrul-Raziqeen

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اِنِّیۡ لِمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡتَ اِلَیَّ مِنۡ خَیۡرٍ فَقِیۡرٌ
duas.english: My Lord! Truly, I am in need of whatever good that You bestow on me!
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innee lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer

duas.arabic: اللّٰہُمَّ مٰلِکَ الۡمُلۡکِ تُؤۡتِی الۡمُلۡکَ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ وَ تَنۡزِعُ الۡمُلۡکَ مِمَّنۡ تَشَآءُ ۫ وَ تُعِزُّ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ وَ تُذِلُّ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ ؕ بِیَدِکَ الۡخَیۡرُ ؕ اِنَّکَ عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیۡءٍ قَدِیۡرٌ، تُوۡلِجُ الَّیۡلَ فِی النَّہَارِ وَ تُوۡلِجُ النَّہَارَ فِی الَّیۡلِ ۫ وَ تُخۡرِجُ الۡحَیَّ مِنَ الۡمَیِّتِ وَ تُخۡرِجُ الۡمَیِّتَ مِنَ الۡحَیِّ ۫ وَ تَرۡزُقُ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ بِغَیۡرِ حِسَابٍ
duas.english: O Allah! Possessor of the kingdom, You give the kingdom to whom You will, and You take the kingdom from whom You will, and You endue with honour whom You will, and You humiliate whom You will. In Your Hand is the good. Verily, You are Able to do all things. You make the night to enter into the day, and You make the day to enter into the night (i.e. increase and decrease in the hours of the night and the day during winter and summer), You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. And You give wealth and sustenance to whom You will, without limit (measure or account).
duas.transliteration: allahumma malika almulkitu/tee almulka man tashao watanziAAu almulka mimman tashaowatuAAizzu man tashao watuthillu man tashaobiyadika alkhayru innaka AAala kulli shay-in qadeer. Tooliju allayla fee annahariwatooliju annahara fee allayli watukhriju alhayyamina almayyiti watukhriju almayyita mina alhayyi watarzuquman tashao bighayri hisab.

duas.arabic: وَ مَا تَوۡفِیۡقِیۡۤ اِلَّا بِاللّٰہِ ؕعَلَیۡہِ تَوَکَّلۡتُ وَ اِلَیۡہِ اُنِیۡبُ
duas.english: My success is not but through Allah. Upon him I have relied, and to Him I return.
duas.transliteration: Wama tawfeeqee illa billahiAAalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi oneeb
duas.note: Prophet Shuaib (AS) recited this dua.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.english: O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health. None has the right to be worshipped except You. O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
duas.transliteration: Allahumma AAafinee fee badanee, allahumma AAafinee fee samAAee, allahumma AAafinee fee basaree, la ilaha illa anta. Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-kufri, walfaqri, Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabri, la ilaha illa anta.
duas.note: Recite this dua three times

duas.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ
duas.english: Do not worry, it will be a purification (for you), Allah willing.
duas.transliteration: Laa ba’sa tahoorun ‘inshaa’Allaah.
duas.note: Prophet (S.A.W.) used to say this Dua whenever He (S.A.W.) visited a an ailing person.

duas.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللّٰهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
duas.english: I ask Allah who is the Lofty and the Lord of the Mighty Throne that He cures you (Prophet Mohammad (SAW.) said that by reciting this dua seven times, the ill person will regain his health and if death occurs then that (death) is a different issue (i.e. death is written it cannot be prevented))
duas.transliteration: As’alullaahal-’Adheema Rabbal-’Arshil-’Adheemi ‘an yashfiyaka.
duas.note: Recite seven times.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ، أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللّٰهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ. (سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ)
duas.english: In the Name of Allah, I seek refuge in the might and power of Allah from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, A’udhu bi’izzatil-lahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhiru.
duas.note: Get relief from pain by placing your hand on the problem area and reciting the dua (seven times).

groups.title: Upon seeing someone going through a trial or tribulation

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً
duas.english: Praise is to Allah Who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and preferred me greatly above much of what He has created.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee ‘aafaanee mimmab-talaaka bihi wa fadhdhalanee ‘alaa katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdheela

groups.title: If you fall on hard times

duas.arabic: اَنِّیۡ مَسَّنِیَ الضُّرُّ وَ اَنۡتَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِیۡنَ
duas.english: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
duas.transliteration: Annee massaniya addurru waanta arhamuarrahimeen
duas.note: Read this dua in times of sickness! Prophet Ayyob (AS) recited this dua when he was suffering from a terrible disease that spread all over his body.

groups.title: When you are nearing your death

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى
duas.english: O Allah, forgive me and have mercy upon me and join me with the highest companions (in Paradise).
duas.transliteration: Allaahum-maghfir lee warhamnee wa ‘alhiqnee bir-rafeeqil-’a’laa

duas.arabic: لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ وَاللّٰهُ اَکۡبَرُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ وَحْدَهُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ لَا شَرِيۡکَ لَهُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ لَهُ الْمُلْکُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰہِِ
duas.english: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Allah is the Most Great. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, His is the dominion and His is the praise. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, there is no power and no might but by Allah.
duas.transliteration: Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu wallaahu ‘Akbar, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu wahdahu, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu laa shareeka lahu, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata ‘illaa billaah

duas.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ نَسْأَلُ اللّٰهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
duas.english: Oh Muslims residing here, salaams on you, by the will of Allah we will also be coming to you. We seek safety for us and you.
duas.transliteration: Assalaamu ‘alaykum ‘ahlad-diyaari, minal-mu’mineena walmuslimeena, wa ‘innaa ‘in shaa’ Allaahu bikum laahiqoona [wa yarhamullaahul-mustaqdimeena minnaa walmusta’khireena] ‘as’alullaaha lanaa wa lakumul- ‘aafiyata.

duas.arabic: [سُوۡرَةُ الفَلَق]  قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ الۡفَلَقِ،  مِنۡ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ اِذَا وَقَب،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ النَّفّٰثٰتِ فِی الۡعُقَدِ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ اِذَا حَسَدَ [سُوۡرَةُ  النَّاس]  ۡقُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِکِ النَّاسِ، اِلٰہِ النَّاسِ، مِنۡ شَرِّ الۡوَسۡوَاسِ الۡخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِیۡ یُوَسۡوِسُ فِیۡ صُدُوۡرِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الۡجِنَّۃِ وَ النَّاسِ
duas.english: [Surah Al-Falaq]Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, From the evil of that which He created, And from the evil of darkness when it settles, And from the evil of the blowers in knots, And from the evil of an envier when he envies." [Surah An-Nas]Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer, Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind, From among the jinn and mankind."
duas.transliteration: [Surah Al-Falaq]Qul ‘A’udhu Bi-Rabbil-Falaq, Min Sharri Ma Khalaq, Wa Min Sharri Ghasiqin ‘Idha Waqab, Wa Min Sharri-Naffathati Fil-‘Uqadi, Wa Min Sharri Hasidin ‘Idha Hasad. [Surah An-Nas]Qul ‘A’udhu Bi-Rabbin-Nas, Malikin-Nas, Ilahin-Nas, Min-Sharril-Waswasil-Khan-Nas, Al-Ladhi Yuwas-wisu Fee Sudurin-Nas, Mina Al-Jinnati Wan-Nas.
duas.note: Whenever Prophet (S.A.W.) became sick, he would recite these two surahs and then blow his breath over his body.

groups.title: For forgiveness for your parents and all Muslims

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغۡفِرۡ لِیۡ وَ لِوَالِدَیَّ وَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ یَوۡمَ یَقُوۡمُ الۡحِسَابُ
duas.english: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir Lee Wa Liwaalidayya Wa Lil-Mu’mineena Yawma Yaqoomul H’isaab

duas.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیۡ ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِیۡ فَاغۡفِرۡ لِیۡ فَغَفَرَ لَہٗ ؕ اِنَّہٗ ہُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِیۡمُ، قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَاۤ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَیَّ فَلَنۡ اَکُوۡنَ ظَہِیۡرًا لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِیۡنَ، رَبِّ نَجِّنِیۡ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ
duas.english: He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful. He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals. My Lord, save me from the wrong doing people.
duas.transliteration: Qala Rabbi innee thalamtunafsee faghfir lee faghafara lahu innahu huwa alghafooruarraheem Qala Rabbi bima anAAamtaAAalayya falan akoona thaheeran lilmujrimeen Rabbi najjinee mina alqawmi aththalimeen

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجۡعَلۡنِیۡ مُقِیۡمَ الصَّلٰوۃِ وَ مِنۡ ذُرِّیَّتِیۡ، رَبَّنَا وَ تَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ
duas.english: O my Lord! Make me one who performs As-Salaat (Iqaamat-as-Salaat), and (also) from my offspring, our Lord! And accept my invocation.
duas.transliteration: Rabbij-A’lnee Muqeemas’ S’alaati Wa Min D’urrriyyatee Rabbanaa Wa Taqabbal Du-A’aa

duas.arabic: رَّبِّ ارۡحَمۡہُمَا کَمَا رَبَّیٰنِیۡ صَغِیۡرًا
duas.english: My Lord, have mercy upon them (parents) as they brought me up [when i was] small.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi  irhamhuma kama rabbayani sagheera

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ہَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ اَزۡوَاجِنَا وَ ذُرِّیّٰتِنَا قُرَّۃَ اَعۡیُنٍ وَّ اجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِیۡنَ اِمَامًا
duas.english: O my Lord! Grant unto us wives and offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes, and give us (the grace) to lead the righteous.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana Hablana min azwaajina wadhurriy-yatina, qurrata ‘ayioni wa-jalna lil-muttaqeena Imaama

groups.title: Asking Allah to grant you a child

duas.arabic: رَبِّ ہَبۡ لِیۡ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ ذُرِّیَّۃً طَیِّبَۃً ۚ اِنَّکَ سَمِیۡعُ الدُّعَآءِ
duas.english: O my Lord! Grant me from You, a good offspring. You are indeed the All-Hearer of invocation.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi Hab Lee Mil Ladunka D’urriyyatan T’ayyibah Innaka Samee-u’d Du’aa
duas.note: Read this dua if you are having trouble having a child! Prophet Zakaria (AS) recited this dua, praying to Allah to grant him a child when he attained old age.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرۡنِیۡ فَرۡدًا وَّ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الۡوٰرِثِیۡنَ
duas.english: O My Lord! Leave me not single (childless), though You are the Best of the inheritors.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi Laa Tad’arnee Fardaw wa Anta Khayrul Waaritheen

groups.title: Say these words when in distress

duas.arabic: اللّٰہُ اللّٰہُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
duas.english: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him.
duas.transliteration: Allahu Allahu Rabbi, la ushriku bihi shai'a

duas.arabic: قَالَتۡ رَبِّ ابۡنِ لِیۡ عِنۡدَکَ بَیۡتًا فِی الۡجَنَّۃِ
duas.english: My Lord! Build me a house in Paradise near You
duas.transliteration: Qaalat rab bibni lee 'indaka baitan fil jannati

groups.title: When you fail or lose at something

duas.arabic: قَدَّرَ اللّٰهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
duas.english: It is the Decree of Allah and He does whatever He wills.
duas.transliteration: Qadarullaahu wa maa shaa’afa’ala

duas.arabic: اِنَّا لِلّٰہِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیۡہِ رٰجِعُوۡنَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
duas.english: We are from Allah and unto Him we return. O Allah take me out of my plight and bring to me after it something better.
duas.transliteration: Innaa lillaahi wa ‘innaa ‘ilayhi raaji’oon, Allaahumma’-jurni fee museebatee wa ‘akhliflee khayran minhaa

duas.arabic: حَسۡبُنَا اللّٰہُ وَ نِعۡمَ الۡوَکِیۡلُ
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for us and the best of those on whom to depend.
duas.transliteration: Hasbunallaahu wa ni’amal-wakeel

duas.arabic: حَسۡبُنَا اللّٰہُ وَ نِعۡمَ الۡوَکِیۡلُ
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for us and the best of those on whom to depend.
duas.transliteration: Hasbunallaahu wa ni’amal-wakeel

duas.arabic: اِنَّمَاۤ اَشۡکُوۡا بَثِّیۡ وَ حُزۡنِیۡۤ  اِلَی اللّٰہِ وَ اَعۡلَمُ مِنَ اللّٰہِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
duas.english: I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you do not know.
duas.transliteration: Innama ashkoo baththee wahuzneeila Allahi waaAAlamu mina Allahi ma lataAAlamoon
duas.note: Prophet Ya'coob (AS) used to recite this dua.

groups.title: At times of worry and sorry

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men (i .e . others).
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘a’oothu bika minal-hammi walhazani, wal’ajzi walkasali, walbukhli waljubni, wa dhala’id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal

duas.arabic: لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ  اِلَّاۤ اَنۡتَ سُبۡحٰنَکَ  اِنِّیۡ کُنۡتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ
duas.english: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrongdoers.
duas.transliteration: Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta subhaanaka ‘innee kuntu minadh-dhaalimeen
duas.note: Prophet Yunus supplicate this Dua to Allah when he was in the belly of the whale.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.english: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment). Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma rahmataka ‘arjoo falaa takilnee ‘ilaa nafsee tarfata ‘aynin, wa ‘aslih lee sha’nee kullahu, laa’ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.english: There is none worthy of worship but Allah the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
duas.transliteration: Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahul-’Adheemul-Haleem, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu Rabbul-’Arshil-’Adheem, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu Rabbus-samaawaati wa Rabbul-’ardhi wa Rabbul-’Arshil-Kareem

duas.arabic: يَا حَىُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
duas.english: O Ever Living, O Self-Sustaining Sustainer! In Your Mercy do I seek relief, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.
duas.transliteration: Ya hayyu ya qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth, Ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men (i .e . others).
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘a’oothu bika minal-hammi walhazani, wal’ajzi walkasali, walbukhli waljubni, wa dhala’id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
duas.english: Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahi ‘alaa kulli haal

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اَفۡرِغۡ عَلَیۡنَا صَبۡرًا وَّ تَوَفَّنَا مُسۡلِمِیۡنَ
duas.english: Our Lord! pour out on us patience, and cause us to die as Muslims.
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa Afrigh A’laynaa S’abraw Wa Tawaffanaa Muslimeen

duas.arabic: رَبِّ احۡکُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ وَ رَبُّنَا الرَّحۡمٰنُ الۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلٰی مَا تَصِفُوۡنَ
duas.english: My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ohkum bilhaqqi wa rabbuna arrahmanul musta’aanu alaa ma tasifoon
duas.note: Read this dua if you are bullied at school or the workplace or are under the rule of tyrants! Prophet (peace be upon him) recited this dua when the disbelievers mocked him and said terrible things about him.

duas.arabic: حَسۡبِیَ اللّٰہُ  لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ   ؕ عَلَیۡہِ تَوَکَّلۡتُ وَ ہُوَ رَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡعَظِیۡمِ
duas.english: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.
duas.transliteration: Hasbiyal-lahu la ilaha illa huwa, AAalayhi tawakkalt, wahuwa rabbul-AAarshil-Aaatheem

duas.arabic: وَ اُفَوِّضُ اَمۡرِیۡۤ اِلَی اللّٰہِ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰہَ بَصِیۡرٌۢ بِالۡعِبَادِ
duas.english: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah . Indeed, Allah is Seeing of [His] servants.
duas.transliteration: wa ufawwidhu amree ila Allahi innallaha baseerun bil ibaad

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لا يَعْلَمُونَ‏
duas.english: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma laa tu’aakhithnee bimaa yaqooloona, waghfir lee maa laa ya’lamoon

duas.arabic: لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّاۤ اللّٰہُ
duas.english: There is none worthy of worship but Allah.
duas.transliteration: Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اَفۡرِغۡ عَلَیۡنَا صَبۡرًا وَّ ثَبِّتۡ اَقۡدَامَنَا وَ انۡصُرۡنَا عَلَی الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ
duas.english: Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance, make our foothold sure, and give us help against the disbelieving folk.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana Afrigh A’layna Sabran wa Thabbit Aqdamana Wansurna A’lal Qawmil Kafireen

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
duas.english: I seek refuge with Allah against the Satan, the outcast.
duas.transliteration: A’oothu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem

duas.arabic: اِنَّا لِلّٰہِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیۡہِ رٰجِعُوۡنَ
duas.english: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.
duas.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raajioon

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.english: O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummak-finee bihalaalika ‘an haraamika wa ‘aghninee bifadhlika ‘amman siwaaka

groups.title: For someone who lends you money

duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللّٰهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ
duas.english: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth, surely the reward for a loan is praise and returning (what was borrowed).
duas.transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka fee ‘ahlika wa maalika, ‘innamaa jazaa’us-salafil-hamdu wal’adaa’

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغۡ قُلُوۡبَنَا بَعۡدَ اِذۡ ہَدَیۡتَنَا وَ ہَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ رَحۡمَۃً ۚ اِنَّکَ اَنۡتَ الۡوَہَّابُ
duas.english: Our Lord! Let not our hearts deviate (from the truth) after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from You. Truly, You are the Bestower.
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa Laa Tuzigh Quloobanaa Ba’-Da Id’hadaytanaa Wa Hab Lanaa Mil Ladunka Rah’mah Innaka Antal Wahaab

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوۡبَنَا وَ اِسۡرَافَنَا فِیۡۤ اَمۡرِنَا وَ ثَبِّتۡ اَقۡدَامَنَا وَ انۡصُرۡنَا عَلَی الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ
duas.english: Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and our transgressions (in keeping our duties to You), establish our feet firmly, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lanaa d’unoobanaa wa israafanaa fee amrinaa wa thabbit aqdaamanaa wan s’urnaa a’lal qawmil kaafireen

duas.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللّٰهِ رَبًّا وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا
duas.english: I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Islam as a religion and Muhammad peace be upon to him as a Prophet.
duas.transliteration: Radeetu billahi rabban wabil-islami deenan wabiMuhammadin nabiyya.

duas.arabic: اَعُوۡذُ بِاللّٰہ
duas.english: I seek refuge in Allah.
duas.transliteration: `A’udhu billah

duas.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللّٰهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
duas.english: I believe in Allah and His Messenger.
duas.transliteration: Aamantu billaahi wa Rusulihi

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا بِمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡتَ وَ اتَّبَعۡنَا الرَّسُوۡلَ فَاکۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ الشّٰہِدِیۡنَ
duas.english: Our Lord! We believe in what Thou hast revealed, and we follow the Messenger. Then write us down among those who bear witness.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana amanna bima anzalta wattaba ‘nar-Rusula fak-tubna ma’ash-Shahideen
duas.note: This dua was asked by the companions of Prophet Isa (AS).

groups.title: Seek forgiveness and strengthen your Imaan

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنَاۤ اِنۡ نَّسِیۡنَاۤ اَوۡ اَخۡطَاۡنَا، رَبَّنَا وَ لَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَیۡنَاۤ اِصۡرًا کَمَا حَمَلۡتَہٗ عَلَی الَّذِیۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِنَا، رَبَّنَا وَ لَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَۃَ لَنَا بِہٖ، وَ اعۡفُ عَنَّا، وَ اغۡفِرۡ لَنَا، وَ ارۡحَمۡنَا، اَنۡتَ مَوۡلٰىنَا فَانۡصُرۡنَا عَلَی الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ
duas.english: Our Lord! Punish us not if we forget or fall into error, our Lord! Lay not on us a burden like that which You did lay on those before us; our Lord! Put not on us a burden greater than we have strength to bear. Pardon us and grant us Forgiveness. Have mercy on us. You are our Maula (Patron, Supporter and Protector, etc.) and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa Laa Too-Akhid’naaa In-Naseenaa Aw Akht’aanaa Rabbanaa wa Laa Tah’mil A’laynaaa Is’ran Kamaa Ha’maltahoo A’lal Lad’eena min Qablinaa Rabbanaa wa Laa Tuh’ammilnaa Maa Laa T’aaqata Lanaa Bih Wa’-Fu A’nnaa Waghfirlanaa Warh’amnaa Anta Mawlaanaa Fans’urnaa A’lal Qawmil Kaafireen

duas.arabic: اِنِّیۡ وَجَّہۡتُ وَجۡہِیَ لِلَّذِیۡ فَطَرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضَ حَنِیۡفًا وَّ مَاۤ اَنَا مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِکِیۡنَ
duas.english: Indeed, I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allah.
duas.transliteration: Innee wajjahtu wajhiya lillathee fataraassamawati wal-arda haneefanwama ana mina almushrikeen

duas.arabic: اِنَّ صَلَاتِیۡ وَ نُسُکِیۡ وَ مَحۡیَایَ وَ مَمَاتِیۡ  لِلّٰہِ  رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ لَا شَرِیۡکَ لَہٗ، وَ بِذٰلِکَ اُمِرۡتُ وَ اَنَا اَوَّلُ الۡمُسۡلِمِیۡنَ
duas.english: Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds. He has no partner. And of this I have been commanded, and I am the first of the Muslims.
duas.transliteration: inna salatee wanusukee wamahyaya wamamatee lillahi rabbil aalameen. La shareeka lahu wa bithalika omirtu wa ana aw walul muslimeen

duas.arabic: فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضِ ۟ اَنۡتَ وَلِیّٖ فِی الدُّنۡیَا وَ الۡاٰخِرَۃِ ۚ تَوَفَّنِیۡ مُسۡلِمًا وَّ اَلۡحِقۡنِیۡ بِالصّٰلِحِیۡنَ
duas.english: Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.
duas.transliteration: fatira assamawatiwal-ardi anta waliyyee fee addunyawal-akhirati tawaffanee musliman waalhiqneebissaliheen
duas.note: Read this dua for good and righteous company. Prophet Yusuf (AS) recited this dua.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا فَاکۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ الشّٰہِدِیۡنَ
duas.english: Our Lord! We believe; write us down among the witnesses.
duas.transliteration: Rabbana aamana faktubna ma’ ash-shahideen

duas.arabic: رَّبِّ زِدۡنِیۡ عِلۡمًا
duas.english: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi Zidnee I’lmaa.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً،  وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً،  وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit, a good provision, and deeds that will be accepted.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘as’aluka ‘ilman naafi’an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa ‘amalan mutaqabbalan
